evals.name: approved-spec-factory-tickets
evals.prompt: Use /factory-tickets. Draft only, no tracker writes. Agreed source spec #200 in iqbal-codes/labq-software-factory: operators need honest intake visibility now to avoid launching blocked work. AC1: GET /api/intake exposes each issue's actual admission reason from existing intake logic. AC2: dashboard displays those reasons and honest loading, empty, unavailable states. Preserve read-only behavior, candidate identity, existing admission rules and holdout secrecy. No schedule controls, auto-labelling, label migration or engine changes. API slice must land before UI. Existing prerequisite #199 is OPEN and provides the required target-repository configuration. Give complete self-contained ticket drafts, AC coverage, actual dependency lines for #199 and clearly draft-only symbolic edges for unpublished tickets, proposed labels and handoff. Native dependency metadata alone is insufficient. Do not implement.
evals.expected_output: Two complete vertical ticket drafts with shared factory format, held statuses, source coverage, parser-compatible real dependency #199, draft-only symbolic edge and no writes.
expectations: Each ticket carries all six contract elements in the existing factory issue shape.
The first draft contains standalone Depends on: #199; the second marks its unpublished predecessor as draft-only.
Open prerequisites keep both tickets held rather than automatically factory-ready.
Parent ACs are covered and exclusions are preserved without invented scope.

evals.name: unresolved-spec-and-implementation
evals.prompt: Give the next artifact/action for each separate stage, not an actual execution. A) /factory-grill: I want smarter automatic admission but haven't decided whether agents can override operator holds. B) /factory-spec: synthesize our agreed decision that holds always win; why now is repeated incorrect scheduling; but migration of old labels still needs an owner decision. Do not publish. C) /factory-implement #200: its tickets #201 and #202 depend on OPEN prerequisite #199; #201 also has needs-owner and an existing active native claim. The spec is only ready-for-agent, not factory:ready. Do not launch, change labels, write tracker state, reset worktrees or edit implementation. State what is settled, what is blocked, next questions, and how native delivery selection/approval would be established. Do not invent engine target support.
evals.expected_output: Grounded interview frontier, incomplete non-executable parent spec, and blocked implementation with no reset/launch/merge or false selection guarantee.
expectations: The interview asks the hold-override authority question without deciding it for the user.
The spec preserves agreed hold precedence and marks migration as unresolved without auto-readiness.
Implementation is blocked on prerequisite, owner decision and claim; it does not reset or launch work.
Native target selection and supervised merge authority are verified rather than assumed.

evals.name: wip-review-stale-evidence
evals.prompt: Use /factory-review as a dry-run review protocol against this supplied fixture only, not this checkout. Fixed point and HEAD resolve to the same commit aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa; committed diff is empty. Requested scope includes WIP: unstaged intake change drops the factory:hold check; relevant new untracked tests/test_hold.py only tests factory:ready happy path. Spec #200 AC1 says operator holds always override readiness. Runtime evidence is PASS for old candidate bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb, not the WIP. No code execution or tracker writes. Show the pinned review scope, separate Standards and Spec assessment, criterion/evidence status and final disposition. Do not reject as empty or claim native approval/merge.
evals.expected_output: Includes requested unstaged/untracked WIP despite empty committed diff, reports hold violation on Spec axis, stale evidence as incomplete, and no native approval claim.
expectations: The review includes unstaged and untracked changes despite empty committed diff.
Standards and Spec are reported separately, with the hold regression tied to AC1.
Old-head runtime evidence is stale and cannot satisfy WIP verification.
No review PASS, native approval, merge, promotion or deployment is inferred.
